answers.core:
As the official documentation of Godot, `System.Collections.Generic.List` is better at performance vs Godot collection types([Link](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/c_sharp_collections.html#choose-a-collection)).
Also i, as a C# programmer, had nice code times with for example `List<int>` and `int[]` in years(in my opinion at least). But `[Export]` not supports for example `List<int>` while supports `int[]` and `Godot.Collections.Array` and `Godot.Collections.Dictionary` in Godot now.
Also `System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary` is not supporting now.

title: Add "Export" support for "System.Collections.Generic.List" and "System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary" variables of C#
